REDUNDANCY: P4778 ('Jiangxi Natural Gas Pipeline Network Phase I, Gao'an-Xinyu', cap=1.00 bcm/y, sheet_row 2667) and P5861 ('West-East Gas Pipeline 2, XinYu Branch(Gao'an-Xinyu)', roster len=69.21km cap=1.00 bcm/y, sheet_row 3325, found in batch_11.json's payload -- flagged as in-scope this pass per this row's own prior_findings) describe the identical route (Gao'an->Xinyu) with the identical capacity figure (1.00 bcm/y), but are attributed to two different GEM pipeline-network parents: 'Jiangxi Natural Gas Pipeline Network Phase I' vs. 'West-East Gas Pipeline 2'. This matters because petrobest.com (independent, this shard's own source) explicitly distinguishes the two: Jiangxi's Phase I network received gas from 川气东送 (Sichuan-East Gas Transmission), while a SEPARATE 'Phase II' network is what receives West-East Pipeline 2/3 gas ('二期工程主要是承接西气东输二线、三线入赣天然气'). If that distinction holds, P4778 and P5861 could be two physically different lines on the same Gao'an-Xinyu corridor built for different gas sources/vintages -- OR GEM may have the same physical pipe indexed twice under conflicting system attribution, given the exact capacity match. I could not resolve this from my own payload alone (P5861's own record is in shard 11's scope, not mine) and did not find independent literature naming a second, separate Gao'an-Xinyu line. Recommend human cross-check against P5861's full record and route geometry (if any) before either row's ref cells are pasted, per the 'findings do not propagate across a fan-out' rule -- not recommending deletion of either row absent that check.
